metadata.title: Geometric chains of orbifolds with corners and singular homology
metadata.abstract: We study a geometric homology theory (GHT for short). Its chains are generated by smooth maps from compact oriented orbifolds with corners to a smooth space, and two kinds of chains are set to zero: those admitting an orientation reversing automorphism, and degenerate ones, which, together with their boundaries, factor through smooth maps to orbifolds of lower dimension. Bisecting the source of a geometric chain along a hypersurface transverse to its corners changes the chain only by the boundary of an explicit prism and by prisms over its faces; cutting a geometric cycle along a regular level set of a smooth function on the target does not change its homology class. Geometric chains also behave well under products and pullbacks along fibre bundles, which overcomes some of the combinatorial rigidity of singular chains. We prove that geometric homology is naturally isomorphic to singular homology with rational coefficients for every smooth space admitting a good cover, such as smooth manifolds, orbifolds and locally finite polyhedra, and also for orbifolds with corners. The proof uses cutting operators along level sets of functions on the target, realized by explicit prisms, instead of triangulations. For continuous maps into arbitrary spaces we conjecture the same statement, and prove it for Euclidean neighbourhood retracts in degrees at most one, with surjectivity in degree two. Without the relation killing degenerate chains the comparison fails for orbifold chains: the weighted projective plane $\mathbb{P}(1,1,p)$, $p\ge5$ prime, mapped to a point is a cycle that does not bound. Applications on Morse theory and the BV structure on geometric chains of moduli spaces of bordered Riemann surfaces, following Costello and Harrelson--Voronov--Zúñiga, are given.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 几何链与奇异同调比较
analysis.workSummary: 以带角定向 orbifold 的光滑映射生成几何链，加入反向自同构和退化链关系，利用切割与显式棱柱证明好覆盖光滑空间上的几何同调等于有理奇异同调。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造对积和纤维丛拉回友好的链模型，避免三角剖分。
analysis.limitations: 一般拓扑空间的连续映射版本仍是猜想；杀去退化链关系不可省，系数为有理数。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Claude Code 检查原有证明的有效性，并在作者指导下草拟一些新证明；总体思想和方法由作者提出。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Claude Code 检查原有证明的有效性，并在作者指导下草拟一些新证明；总体思想和方法由作者提出。

analysis.priorityReason: 可用于 Morse 理论与模空间链级操作的基础模型。
